bandReport.notes: 26 questions, Q95-Q120 contiguous, no gaps and no duplicates. Page map: p18 = printed p37 (Q95-100), p19 = printed p39 (Q101-104), p20 = printed p41 (Q105-110), p21 = printed p43 (Q111-116), p22 = printed p45 (Q117-120). Only the odd (English) pages of this bilingual booklet were scanned; Hindi bleed-through from the reverse is visible on every page but carries no English content. FIRST: Q95 begins clean at the top of p18's left column - nothing spills over from p17, so B3 should end complete at Q94. LAST: the paper genuinely ends at Q120. Its option block finishes mid-way down p22's right column and the rest of that column is blank; p22 is the last page of the PDF (23 pages, p00-p22) and there is no trailing blank or rough-work page in the scan. The '[ P.T.O.' footer still prints on p22 - verified at 8x - but that is the standard footer of the physical bilingual booklet (the Hindi half follows on printed p46), not evidence of a missing English question. Nothing visible on my pages belongs to a neighbouring band. NON-STANDARD CODE ORDER on two questions, both re-read at 7-8x: Q97 runs (a) 1 and 2 only / (b) 1, 2 and 3 / (c) 1 and 3 only / (d) 3 only, and Q120 runs (a) 1, 2 and 3 / (b) 1 and 2 only / (c) 2 only / (d) 1 and 3 only - in both the all-three option is NOT at (d). CLASSIFICATION CALL taken for consistency, flagged here so the merge can see it: for the two non-dated multilateral-body questions I sent the body to its subject home per the brief's structure-vs-event rule - Q114 (RCEP, what the agreement is + India opting out) to Economics > International Trade and Finance, and Q116 (SCO goals + Iran's membership) to Polity > United Nations and Global Institutions - rather than to Current Affairs > International Organizations and Multilateral Bodies. Q115 (a dated lithium agreement) did go to Current Affairs.
